Title: Insulin Resistance - More Than 2 in 5 US Adults Have It

Description:
More than 2 in 5 US adults have insulin resistance or prediabetes, and most don't know it. Three habits make it worse: visceral fat releases fatty acids and inflammatory chemicals that block insulin, sugary drinks trigger fat production in the liver even in moderate doses, and chronic stress raises cortisol, which builds more visceral fat in a vicious cycle. Losing just 5-7% of body weight can cut diabetes risk in half — cut back on sugary drinks and take short stress breaks to help insulin work better.
